name: Droggn
description: Droggn is a three-player Tyrolean Tarock game from the Stubai valley, played with a 66-card French-suited Tarock pack.

content.text: Droggn is a three-player Tyrolean Tarock game from the Stubai valley, played with a 66-card French-suited Tarock pack.

The game is centered in the Stubaital (Stubai Valley) southwest of Innsbruck. Its introduction is shrouded in legend, with roots potentially tied to Tyrolean resistance hero Andreas Hofer or traveling Italian merchants.
66-card deck (Industrie und Glück pattern with lowest cards removed). 22 Tarocks, 44 suit cards.
21 cards per player, dealt in batches of 7. 3-card talon face down in centre.

items.text: Deal and talon position: Talon may be dealt in the middle (e.g. after second batch of 7) rather than at end. One variant: deal in batches of 5-5-5-3-3 then talon.
Exposing the talon: In ordinary game some players have declarer expose the talon before picking it up; in Solo declarer picks up without showing. Others say declarer never shows the talon.
Game with 78 cards: Played with full 78-card pack. Deal in 5s; declarer needs 39 card points to win. Super Mord score probably 169. Otherwise rules same.
